rev.t: All Set has been my go to prop rental place in Bangalore for most of my shoots. Their curation is vast and fabulous, and both Varsha and Alok are extremely pleasant and super helpful. Have also enjoyed working at their studio in Indiranagar. It’s easy to access, clean and colourful. Would always recommend!

It's a great place to do any brand ad film shoot or podcast format videos, the studio has a huge number of cool props and set of furnitures that can be used in any different style of film format. The owner is very sweet and helped us a lot …

Pretty convenient, and a great place to shoot. One of the very few studio spaces in Bangalore with a bedroom, and a full size living room. A lot of props to choose from to build and create your set as per the vibe.
